title: 黃仁勳 × Stripe 對談
subtitle: 寧可磨練你，也不放棄你

credit.video_title: 不開除人的老闆，自己離開了｜黃仁勳：「我寧可磨練他們成就卓越」辭職前兩年半談為什麼不開除人｜真實訪談精選、單字解釋、雙語字幕
credit.channel: 一句英文 One Sentence English

sentences.en: You once told me that you really didn't like firing people and very seldom did it.
sentences.zh: 你曾經跟我說過，你真的不喜歡開除人，而且很少這麼做。

sentences.en: Can you elaborate on that?
sentences.zh: 可以多談談嗎？

sentences.en: Well, I'd rather improve you than give up on you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我寧可讓你進步，也不想放棄你。

sentences.en: You know, when you fire somebody, you're kind of saying, you're kind of saying, well, you know, a lot of people say, well, it wasn't your fault or I made the wrong choice.
sentences.zh: 你知道，當你開除一個人，你等於是在說，嗯，很多人會說，嗯，那不是你的錯，是我選錯人了。

sentences.en: And so there's a, it's kind of tongue in cheek, but people know that I'd rather torture them into greatness.

sentences.zh: 對，我記得你提過。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'd rather torture you into greatness because I believe in you.
sentences.zh: 對，所以我寧可磨練你，讓你成就卓越，因為我相信你。

sentences.en: And I think coaches that really believe in their team torture them into greatness.
sentences.zh: 我認為真心相信自己球隊的教練，就會磨練他們成就卓越。

sentences.en: And oftentimes they're so close.
sentences.zh: 而且他們往往已經很接近了。

sentences.en: Don't give up.
sentences.zh: 別放棄。

sentences.en: They're so close.
sentences.zh: 他們真的很接近了。

sentences.en: You know, greatness kind of, it comes all of a sudden one day is like, I got it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，卓越有點像是，某一天突然就來了，你會說：我懂了。

sentences.en: Do you know what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思嗎？

sentences.en: That feeling that you didn't get it yesterday and all of a sudden one day something clicking, I got it.
sentences.zh: 那種感覺就是，昨天還不懂，某天突然豁然開朗：我懂了。

sentences.en: Could you imagine you gave up that, just that moment right before you got it?
sentences.zh: 你能想像自己放棄了嗎，就在你快要開竅的前一刻？

sentences.en: You know, so I don't want you to give up on that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不希望你在那時放棄。

sentences.en: So I'll just keep torturing you.
sentences.zh: 所以我會繼續磨練你。

sentences.en: How, how's your work-life balance?
sentences.zh: 那個，你的工作與生活平衡得如何？

sentences.en: How, how do you do that?
sentences.zh: 那個，你是怎麼做到的？

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼做到的？

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎麼做到的？

sentences.en: Well, it depends on who you ask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，這要看你問誰。

sentences.en: I think my work-life balance is really great.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我的工作與生活平衡得非常好。

sentences.en: It's really great.
sentences.zh: 真的非常好。

sentences.en: I work as much as I can.
sentences.zh: 我盡可能地多工作。

sentences.en: And I feel like he's judging me.
sentences.zh: 我覺得他在評斷我。

sentences.en: You know, I have, I'm older than you.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我比你年長。

sentences.en: I have more wisdom than you.
sentences.zh: 我比你更有智慧。

sentences.en: So what I...
sentences.zh: 所以我……

sentences.en: Well, I work as...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我工作……

sentences.en: I work from the moment I wake up to the moment I go to bed.
sentences.zh: 從我醒來的那一刻到上床睡覺，我都在工作。

sentences.en: And I work seven days a week.
sentences.zh: 而且我一週工作七天。

sentences.en: When I'm not working, I'm thinking about working.
sentences.zh: 沒在工作的時候，我也在想著工作。

sentences.en: And when I'm working, I'm working.
sentences.zh: 而在工作的時候，我就全心工作。

sentences.en: And so...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: I sit through movies, but I don't remember them because I'm thinking about work.
sentences.zh: 我會坐著看完整部電影，但我完全不記得內容，因為我都在想工作。

sentences.en: NVIDIA has a market cap of roughly $2 trillion.
sentences.zh: 輝達的市值大約是兩兆美元。

sentences.en: And you're now within spitting distance of Apple and Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 而你們現在已經逼近蘋果和微軟了。

sentences.en: And I just checked, and they have 220,000 and 160,000 employees, respectively.
sentences.zh: 我剛查了一下，他們分別有 22 萬名和 16 萬名員工。

sentences.en: NVIDIA has 28,000 employees.
sentences.zh: 輝達有 2 萬 8 千名員工。

sentences.en: So, you know, less than a fifth of the smaller of the two there.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，還不到兩者中較小那家的五分之一。

sentences.en: And then you just said, when we were chatting backstage, and I jotted this down, you can achieve operational excellence through process, but craft can only be achieved with tenure.
sentences.zh: 然後你剛才在後台聊天時說過，我把這句話記了下來，你可以透過流程達到卓越的營運，但工藝只能靠資歷累積才能達成。

sentences.en: And so, NVIDIA is considerably smaller than any of the other giants.
sentences.zh: 所以，輝達的規模比其他巨頭都小得多。

sentences.en: And you seem to think that tenure really matters, and I guess that craft really matters.
sentences.zh: 而你似乎認為資歷真的很重要，我想你也認為工藝真的很重要。

sentences.en: Do you want to say a little bit more there?
sentences.zh: 你願意再多談談這部分嗎？

sentences.en: The...
sentences.zh: 這個……

sentences.en: I think extraordinary...
sentences.zh: 我認為，非凡的……

sentences.en: I think a lot of good things could be made...
sentences.zh: 我認為很多好東西都能被做出來……

sentences.en: Good things are made with operational excellence.
sentences.zh: 好東西是靠卓越的營運做出來的。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: But you can't make extraordinary things through just operational excellence.
sentences.zh: 但你無法做出非凡的東西，光靠卓越的營運是不夠的。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is because a lot of the great things in your body of work, in the products that you make, the company you created, the organizations you've nurtured, it takes loving care.
sentences.zh: 原因在於，你許多偉大的成就，在你的作品當中，在你做的產品、你創辦的公司裡，在你悉心培育的組織裡，都需要傾注愛與關懷。

sentences.en: And you can't even put it in words.
sentences.zh: 而且你甚至無法用言語表達。

sentences.en: How do you put loving care in an email?
sentences.zh: 你要怎麼把愛與關懷寫進電子郵件裡？

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道嗎？

sentences.en: And for people to go, oh, I know exactly what to do.
sentences.zh: 然後讓大家說：喔，我完全知道該怎麼做了。

sentences.en: You can't put that in...
sentences.zh: 你沒辦法把它放進……

sentences.en: You know, you can't put that in a business process.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你沒辦法把它放進企業流程裡。

sentences.en: Love and care.
sentences.zh: 愛與關懷。

sentences.en: Is love and care kind of an NVIDIA catchphrase?
sentences.zh: 「愛與關懷」算是輝達的口頭禪嗎？

sentences.en: Well, I use love fairly abundantly, and care I use abundantly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我用「愛」用得相當頻繁，「關懷」也用得很多。

sentences.en: At Stripe, we talk a lot about craft and beauty.
sentences.zh: 在 Stripe，我們常談工藝與美感。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 對，沒錯。

sentences.en: You have to use these words because in a lot of ways, there are no other words to describe it.
sentences.zh: 你必須用這些字眼，因為在很多方面，沒有別的詞可以形容它。

sentences.en: You can't put in numbers.
sentences.zh: 你無法用數字呈現。

sentences.en: You can't write it in a product specification.
sentences.zh: 你無法把它寫進產品規格裡。

sentences.en: The product specification says, I want you to build something great that's incredibly beautiful, and create, create craft.
sentences.zh: 產品規格寫的是：我要你打造出偉大、美得不可思議的東西，並創造出工藝。

sentences.en: You can't specify these things.
sentences.zh: 這些事是無法明確規定的。

sentences.en: But I'm sure there's people at Stripe who think, you know, Patrick's always yammering on about craft and beauty, and it's this kind of...
sentences.zh: 但我相信 Stripe 裡一定有人覺得，Patrick 老是在碎碎念工藝和美感，而且這有點像是……

sentences.en: I never yammer.
sentences.zh: 我從不碎碎念。

sentences.en: I just want to let you know that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想讓你知道這一點。

sentences.en: I don't even know what that sounds like.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道那聽起來是什麼樣子。

sentences.en: Okay, well...
sentences.zh: 好吧，嗯……

sentences.en: Yammering on.
sentences.zh: 碎碎念個不停。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 請說。

sentences.en: You're more lucid than I am.
sentences.zh: 你比我更有條理。

sentences.en: I just babble.
sentences.zh: 我只是在胡言亂語。

sentences.en: But hey, so Patrick is always going on about this craft and beauty stuff, and he wants things to have this particular ineffable character, but it doesn't directly serve some customer need and so forth.
sentences.zh: 不過，Patrick 總是會一直講這些工藝和美感的事，他希望東西有一種難以言喻的特質，但這並不直接滿足客戶的某種需求之類的。

sentences.en: Like, customers aren't coming to us and saying, I want the product to be more beautiful.
sentences.zh: 比如，客戶不會跑來跟我們說，我希望產品更美一點。

sentences.en: They're saying, I want it to feature X or feature Y.
sentences.zh: 他們會說，我要它有功能 X 或功能 Y。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, we believe that the craft and beauty really matters.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道，我們相信工藝和美感真的很重要。

sentences.en: Sounds like you're getting at something similar.
sentences.zh: 聽起來你想說的也類似。

sentences.en: Why do you think it matters?
sentences.zh: 你覺得為什麼這很重要？

sentences.en: Actually, your customers, even though they didn't say it, they might not have the words to say it, but when they experience it, they know it.
sentences.zh: 其實，你的客戶雖然沒說出口，他們可能不知道怎麼用言語表達，但一旦親身體驗到，他們就知道了。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 這毫無疑問。

sentences.en: Look, look.
sentences.zh: 你看，你看。

sentences.en: Stripe's work has beauty, has elegance, has simplicity.
sentences.zh: Stripe 的作品有美感、有優雅、也有簡潔。

sentences.en: Simplicity is not simple, as you guys know.
sentences.zh: 簡潔並不簡單，你們都知道的。

sentences.en: Simplicity and simple are not the same thing.
sentences.zh: 「簡潔」和「簡單」不是同一回事。

sentences.en: And it has elegance, and it solves the problem, but just enough.
sentences.zh: 它很優雅，能解決問題，但恰到好處就好。

sentences.en: It burdens you, but not too much.
sentences.zh: 它會給你一些負擔，但不會太多。

sentences.en: And so, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，對吧？

sentences.en: And that balance is hard to find.
sentences.zh: 而那種平衡很難拿捏。

sentences.en: And you can't specify that.
sentences.zh: 而且你沒辦法把它明確規定出來。

sentences.en: You just feel your way there.
sentences.zh: 你只能一路摸索過去。

sentences.en: And when you have a team that's with you, that feels the way there together, in a lot of ways, we've codified, we've encoded the magic of the company in a way that no words can describe.
sentences.zh: 當你有一個與你同心的團隊，一起摸索著走過去，在很多方面，我們就把公司的魔力編碼、用一種言語無法形容的方式保存下來。

sentences.en: And you don't want to lose that.
sentences.zh: 而你不會想失去那個東西。

sentences.en: You don't want to lose that.
sentences.zh: 你不會想失去它。

sentences.en: You want to take that and take it to the next level, next time.
sentences.zh: 你想承接它，下一次再把它提升到更高的境界。

sentences.en: And so, I don't want to reset.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不想重新來過。

sentences.en: I don't like working with new people for that reason.
sentences.zh: 我不喜歡和新人共事，就是這個原因。

sentences.en: Because I've encoded, I've embodied, I've deposited so much pain, suffering, joy, knowledge, right?
sentences.zh: 因為我已經把它編碼、體現在我投入了那麼多痛苦、煎熬、喜悅和知識，對吧？

sentences.en: All that experience, life experience, you've encoded it in all the people that you've worked with.
sentences.zh: 所有那些經驗、人生經歷，都已經編碼在所有跟你共事過的人身上。

sentences.en: You want to carry it on.
sentences.zh: 你想把它延續下去。

sentences.en: You want to take it to the next level.
sentences.zh: 你想把它提升到更高的層次。

sentences.en: And that's really the reason why I really deeply believe in tenure.
sentences.zh: 這真的就是我如此深信資深年資的原因。

sentences.en: And because of that, small teams could do great things.
sentences.zh: 也因為這樣，小團隊也能成就大事。

sentences.en: And NVIDIA's kind of a small team where 28,000 people, people think we punch well above our weight because of that reason.
sentences.zh: 而輝達算是個小團隊，雖然有 28,000 人，大家覺得我們的表現遠遠超出我們的規模，就是因為這個原因。

sentences.en: And so, it's amazing what you guys have done and how incredibly small you are, 7,000 people, supporting a trillion dollars worth of ecosystem and industry and economy.
sentences.zh: 所以，你們所做到的事真的很了不起，而且你們的規模小得令人難以置信，只有 7,000 人，卻支撐著價值上兆美元的生態系、產業與經濟。

sentences.en: Who knows how far you guys can go?
sentences.zh: 誰知道你們還能走多遠？

sentences.en: So, I'm very proud of you.
sentences.zh: 我真的以你們為榮。

sentences.en: Jensen, thank you.
sentences.zh: 黃仁勳，謝謝你。

vocab.zh: 表現超出自身規模／實力
